section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA -2000 N.C.R.B.,(M.H.A.) 2.11.2 As in the past, the four metropolitan cities Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi and Mumbai reported higher number of Suicides. These four cities have reported (48.6%) of the suicides reported from 23 mega cities. While Bangalore, Chennai and Mumbai reported decreases of 10.6%, 5.1% & 14.22% respectively, Delhi reported an increase of 2.5 per cent over 1999.
